## `neuro.array.at`

Instance method on `Array.prototype`.

> Returns the item located at the specified index.

## Signatures

```ts
at(input: { array: <receiver>; index: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<T>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Array.prototype.at` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.

## Example

<Code
  lang="ts"
  code={atob("")}
  wrap
